name: Gawain
source:
"Anyway, I'm going to bring the hammer down on these perverts."

Based on Gawain (also called Gwalchmei, Gualguanus, Gauvain, Walwein, etc.), who is King Arthur's nephew and a Knight of the Round Table in the Arthurian legend.

A knight of the Round Table who serves [url=/c5147]Arthur[/url] directly. Gawain always acts gracefully, taking to heart her role as a high-class lady. Even amongst the mighty knights of the Round Table, her battle prowess is top class.

Gawain likes black te and her tea-brewing skills have gained Arthur's stamp of approval. She never leaves her room at night.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char12b]English official site[/url]]
